answer.summary: Verify the definition, measurement conditions, and experimental coverage of the per-interval retention metric in Section 4.1 of Kumar et al., 2024 under intermittent input and bounded token budgets.
answer.content: Conduct a focused source investigation to confirm the per-interval retention metric's explicit definition, its measurement protocol under intermittent input, and the availability of data points across 100 update intervals under bounded token budgets as reported in Section 4.1 of the primary source. Acceptance criteria: the metric must be directly defined, tied to interval-level retention, and supported by explicit experimental conditions without reference to model coherence or broader performance indicators. No extrapolation beyond the source's reported scope is permitted.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to formulate a revised research question on memory retention probability in tokenized agents under intermittent input with known perturbations, anchored solely to the per-interval retention metric in Section 4.1 of 'Stability and Forgetting in Autoregressive Models' by Kumar et al., 2024, and including its variation over 100 update intervals under bounded token budgets
answer.lesson: All memory research questions must be anchored in a single, explicitly reported and verifiable metric from peer-reviewed literature before comparative analysis can proceed; unresolved validation gaps must be explicitly recorded and bounded to prevent premature or unfounded assumptions in subsequent planning stages.'
